overview_description.description: Cowlar makes wearables for dairy cows. They help farms boost productivity. Benifits include high reproduction rates, happy & healthy cows, higher milk yields and lower risk of losses. A farmers can simply strap one around a cow's neck and we're good to go. Their product provides best value for $$, easy to use, easy to install and easy to maintain.
